* Hello, 世界

Welcome to a tour of the [[⟪GTI18N_491d9386_000001⟫][⟪GTI18N_491d9386_000002⟫ programming language]].

The tour is divided into a list of modules that you can
access by clicking on
[[⟪GTI18N_491d9386_000003⟫][A Tour of ⟪GTI18N_491d9386_000004⟫]] on the top left of the page.

You can also view the table of contents at any time by clicking on the [[⟪GTI18N_491d9386_000005⟫][menu]] on the top right of the page.

Throughout the tour you will find a series of slides and exercises for you
to complete.

You can navigate through them using

- [[⟪GTI18N_491d9386_000006⟫]["previous"]] or ⟪GTI18N_491d9386_000007⟫ to go to the previous page,

- [[⟪GTI18N_491d9386_000008⟫]["next"]] or ⟪GTI18N_491d9386_000009⟫ to go to the next page.

The tour is interactive. Click the
[[⟪GTI18N_491d9386_000010⟫][Run]] button now
(or press ⟪GTI18N_491d9386_000011⟫ + ⟪GTI18N_491d9386_000012⟫) to compile and run the program on
#appengine: a remote server.
your computer.
The result is displayed below the code.

These example programs demonstrate different aspects of ⟪GTI18N_491d9386_000013⟫. The programs in the tour are meant to be starting points for your own experimentation.

Edit the program and run it again.

When you click on [[⟪GTI18N_491d9386_000014⟫][Format]]
(shortcut: ⟪GTI18N_491d9386_000015⟫ + ⟪GTI18N_491d9386_000016⟫), the text in the editor is formatted using the
[[⟪GTI18N_491d9386_000017⟫][⟪GTI18N_491d9386_000018⟫]] tool. You can switch syntax highlighting on and off
by clicking on the [[⟪GTI18N_491d9386_000019⟫][syntax]] button.

When you're ready to move on, click the [[⟪GTI18N_491d9386_000020⟫][right arrow]] below or type the ⟪GTI18N_491d9386_000021⟫ key.
